item.title: Lila Rose encourages Life Fest attendees: 'We speak the truth and we love'
item.description: "We are going out there to show people the model of how to advocate for life, how to advocate against evil, but to do it with love," Rose told the crowd.

item.title: Kentucky AG to investigate abortion pill ads running at gas stations
item.description: Kentucky Attorney General Russell Coleman announced his office is investigating abortion pill ads placed at gas stations within the state.

item.title: New poll: Most Americans continue to support restrictions on abortion
item.description: Despite most identifying as "pro-choice" instead of "pro-life," most also support restricting abortion to the first trimester or to mother's life/rape/incest.

item.title: Defying the Odds: Meet these preemies who survived birth at 21 weeks
item.description: Thanks to medical technology advancements, the number of babies who survive birth as young as 21 weeks continues to grow.

item.title: Trump FDA seeks pause on abortion pill lawsuit while it reviews drug's risks
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration under the Trump administration has petitioned a federal court to pause the state of Louisiana's abortion pill lawsuit.

item.title: Supreme Court vacates Sixth Circuit ruling on Title X funds for Tennessee
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has vacated an abortion-related ruling by the Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals and remanded it back to the lower court, noting that the case became moot as it proceeded through the courts.

item.title: Manslaughter probe carried out amid dozens of stillbirths at NHS hospitals
item.description: The Nottinghamshire police force has intensified its probe into maternity failures at Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust.

item.title: Mamdani announces new NYC clinics offering ‘reproductive care’ to young people
item.description: The document doesn't elaborate on “reproductive care,” but the term is commonly defined to include abortion, contraception, & even “gender reassignment.”

item.title: Pregnant Students' Rights Act stalls in Senate after passing in House
item.description: Pregnant students are often unaware of their rights and may have abortions or leave school because they believe they cannot continue their education.

item.title: New bill would restore abortion pill safeguards erased by Biden administration
item.description: The "SAVE" Moms and Babies Act would restore a prohibition on mail-order or telemed abortion, as well as in-person dispensing by a medical professional.
